# NomadUY

> A free guide for people coming to Uruguay for a trip, a temporary stay or a permanent move. Practical information and community in Spanish, English and Portuguese.

Maintained by the NomadUY team. Editorial contact: info@nomad.com.uy.
Access to NomadUY is free; third-party services may charge fees. NomadUY is not a government agency and does not process residency applications. Confirm current requirements, prices and availability with the linked authority or provider.
